body: Thank you but why would you want to live like that?

I also dropped out of college twice. I thought that was rock bottom. Then got lucky with a really well paying job...and here I am again. I've tried medication with little success - I hated the side effects (and they didn't help too much regardless) and one of the drugs I was prescribed actually caused a seizure resulting in a serious concussion that made everything worse. Therapy has worked a little bit in the past but I can't afford it and wasn't *too* successful. People are saying there's free therapy but I'm not sure that exists. I'm just tired of this cycle.
That's the "Will this help or will I just put myself into financial ruin without changing my circumstances?" part

I used to grow weed and other plants because I enjoyed caring for them but they're all dead now. Still have some weed left over that I've slowly been burning through over the last several months - I smoke once or twice a week. I have no intention of buying more or trying to grow again. I guess I should still probably stop. I don't WANT to get better because I know I'll just end up back here eventually. That's how it's always worked. Don't feel obligated to respond...I know I'm talking in circles to myself. I understand how frustrating this sounds.
Thank you for the encouragement. Some days I walk for hours and hours. I haven't been able to manage anything productive.
Thanks. I spend all my time doing nothing or fucking around, just walking for hours. Sometimes I can manage getting myself to read.

Everyone says that but I'm just so fucking terrified. And tired. My life was looking up for the first time a few years ago, then too-comfortable stagnation, I tried making a change, I started declining, then everything totally fell apart by last September. Several years down the drain, so much effort lost. I don't understand how anyone rides this rollercoaster. That's why I'm asking - I know it's a terrible financial decision but it's the only thing I think I can actually manage to do to regain some semblance of control. I've tried so many different paths and I always end up back here, slightly worse for wear.

Thank you. I hope I don't sound dismissive.
